title: DSA, AIA, and LLMs: Approaches to conceptualizing and auditing moderation in LLM-based chatbots across languages and interfaces in the electoral contexts
reasoning: The paper focuses on auditing Large Language Model (LLM) moderation in the context of electoral integrity and political misinformation. While it briefly mentions ethical standards and uses an example involving religious imagery (the Pope) to illustrate model fine-tuning, it does not evaluate or benchmark religion, spiritual traditions, or ethical systems as a core component of its study.
